summary: Added handleGoalEdit regression coverage in src/telegram/goal-commands.test.ts for camelCase false positives and valid working-dir phrases. Negative cases: 'workingDir: string' and 'workingDirectory: string' now assert no working-dir parse override (revision uses original cwd). Positive cases assert parsing for 'working dir should be /home/user/project', 'set working directory to /tmp/build', 'workdir: /opt/app', and 'Working Directory: /var/data'. Verification: pnpm build passed, pnpm lint passed, pnpm vitest run src/telegram/goal-commands.test.ts passed (157/157). pnpm vitest run src/telegram/ failed due pre-existing unrelated createTelegramBot test failures plus worker OOM in this environment.
